The glasses weigh about 100 grams and connect to a pocket-sized puck housing the processor, battery and storage. They feature a 5K micro-OLED "Infinite Display" with up to a 120Hz refresh rate.

It will support the full Meta Quest catalog, Xbox Cloud Gaming, 3D movies and immersive live sports. Users can also connect the glasses to Mac and Windows computers and use them as virtual external displays.
Meta plans to launch the VR glasses in spring 2027 for $1,299.
